basicInfo.Inspection Report: The casing is intact but its structure and strength does not meet the minimum standard. Due to the operator's strong resistance, chassis inspection can't be performed and its relevant data is missing. Due to the operator's aggressiveness, Arts Core inspection cannot be inspected normally although it can be assumed that it is working properly. During the filing process, the operator is highly uncooperative resulting in several information being missing or several inconclusive maintenance report. The specific situation has been reported and is awaiting re-inspection. "Reported? What gives you the right to report to Kal'tsit without my complaint!" Gallus²

review.official:
A unique entity called Gallus² is a small hut constructed from glass and metal supported by a claw like feet. The hut is adorned by a few biomass feathers on its back and feet.
Found in the core of the Sarcophagus in Zelgrad, it's confirmed as a life form from ten thousand years ago with its memories intact, mostly related to
Kal'tsit
.
After being evacuated from Zelgrad, it followed Kal'tsit all the way to Rhodes Island, acting as historical and biological consultant alongside as a field operator.

files.description:
【最高速度】55km/h
【爬坡能力】优良
【制动效能】优良
【通过性】优良
【续航】普通
【结构稳定性】缺陷

GALLUS²并不避讳谈及它与凯尔希同行的时光，或者说，它有些太热衷于讲述那些故事了。它声称自己曾不遗余力地为凯尔希寻来研究所需的一切样本，从土壤、岩石，到植物、昆虫。甚至，利用某些“特殊手段”（笔者注：充当诱饵），它能把那些比自己大上几十倍的大型掠食动物完好无损地带到凯尔希面前。
但当有人问及凯尔希的“研究”具体是什么的时候，GALLUS²就会立刻失去兴致，不耐烦地开始挠地板，然后破口大骂。
“干嘛，干嘛？我在讲我的故事，你们在听什么？凯尔希的‘研究’，我不了解，也不在乎。我帮她做那些，是为了搞清楚哪些虫子鸡吃了最容易消化，哪些树枝撅来做窝最结实，哪些动物的毛薅来做窝最保暖。我只花十五年就研究明白了一只鸡最完美的生活该是什么模样，我难道不是一个伟大的研究者？你们难道不该关注我的成果？”
说完这些话，它又总会怅然若失地用尾羽在它刚刚挠过的地板上扫来扫去。也许它是想起来，如今已经没有第二只和它一样的鸡了，又或者它是意识到，如今就连它自己，也没了进食和筑巢的必要。
这样的状况在GALLUS²身上持续了约半个月之久，直到我们十分不解地发现，它开始频繁光顾工程部，不仅追着可露希尔要求她对自己进行改装，还会擅自“啃食”工作间存放的每一样零件。
在问责时，GALLUS²坚决拒绝承认错误，它骄傲地跳到空调顶上，发表了如下言论：
“我想通了！现在我的研究项目，是试验这片大地上的每一种物质，看看它们对于一只顶着屋子的玻璃铁皮鸡有什么作用！再花十五年，我将会彻底弄清楚一只玻璃铁皮鸡最完美的生活该是什么模样！我难道不是一个伟大的研究者？你们难道不该......（后略）”
......也好。

以空白源石“奥卡”为基底，以源石内存留的生命信息为形式，经由石棺的创生作用，就有概率复现曾经存在过的生命形态，GALLUS²的诞生原理清晰明了。但当它和可露希尔一齐看向镜子时，双方还是露出了不解的表情——
为什么是一座小屋？

经过多次比对，我们确认，该小屋形制上最接近一种在乌萨斯广袤土地上几乎已经绝迹的建筑——自称为“自由民”的群体所使用过的驮行小屋——一种仅有电话亭一半大小，直接架设在驮兽背上的特殊建筑。
奇怪的是，这种建筑很小，甚至连一个成年人也容不下；数量也很少，一整个自由民部族的遗址当中，往往只能发现一两座。既然不可能是民居，它在自由民的生活中，又发挥着怎样的作用？
我们在自由民的脏话里找到了答案。“老祖母在上”，他们惊讶时这么说，生气时这么说，被驮兽踢了也这么说。“老祖母”似乎就是自由民的信仰对象——毕竟他们总不可能去信仰皇帝。
自由民的传说当中，“老祖母”最鲜明的特点，就是她总带着一个长脚的小屋。“老祖母”向自由民索取许多——他们的驮兽、他们的刀和弓箭，甚至是他们用血换来的战利品。她让人们把这些物件放进小屋，然后牵着小屋转身离去。有些人咒骂她是强取豪夺的邪恶女巫，但更多人相信，“老祖母”是替他们拒绝了死亡，她用这些物件作为代价，挡住了死亡的脚步。这样，自由民就还能再多走几年路，多见几轮春花，又或者，多上几次战场。
所以，自由民每每踏上战场之前，都要在驮行小屋里给“老祖母”献上点什么，以求死亡能晚一点降临。
只不过，“老祖母”终归不是万能的。当一个人再也交不出任何东西——他的刀已经断过三次，兄弟姊妹都被埋在不同的战场，他连仇恨的力气也全部失去，“老祖母”便会沉默地挪开小屋，向他指明通向死亡的路。
“我不能再替你挡了。”“老祖母”最后这样说道。

所以，这一切与GALLUS²有什么关系？
好吧，“老祖母”的传说总要有个出处，不是吗？最早，自由民还在为乌萨斯的建国伟业流血的时候，就传唱过一位与他们一同行走、为他们治病疗伤的女巫的事迹。女巫常给部族里的孩子们讲故事，而她讲得最多的，就是“长脚的小屋”。
“长脚的小屋打败怪物”“长脚的小屋寻找家园”——一代又一代的孩子听着这些故事长大，一代又一代的自由民就这样记住了这座长脚的小屋。
那位女巫是谁，她故事里的那座小屋的原型又是谁，想必不难猜到。考虑到信息敏感性，我们就这样记录吧：那是位身穿绿衣的菲林，而她口中的小屋，长着鸡的脚爪。

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's not as if I can't do for you what I did for Kal'tsit. Whether it's insects, grains, or apex predators a dozen meters long, I can fetch you specimens of any organism. How would you carry that…? Who taught you to ask such rude questions?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You can have this 'high-grade feed'. The biologists gave it to me, but I find it revolting. You know, each and every one of them begged me to tell them all about the insects I saw back in the day. So I did. And they fell asleep! They want to write the 'entomological magnum opus', but don't even care about taste or texture? Then stop writing!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Kal'tsit was never this gloomy when she was still on four legs. What's wrong with her? It only took me fifteen years to perfectly solve my chicken life, but she's had all this time and only gotten worse… You know, maybe she needs my help to work out the ultimate Felidae diet?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: What do you mean, your Originium? Those stones I swallowed are my grit, and they aid in digestion, and they're very important, okay? Wait, wait, wait, what are you doing? Listen! This hut is like a piggy bank—you only get out what's inside by smashing it. You wouldn't do that to me for a few worthless pebbles, yes?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Really? Kal'tsit died so she could save you? My Kal'tsit did nothing but say 'scanning, 50% complete' while her specimens chased me, and you're telling me she saves people now? Was it you who turned her this way, or… It was herself? Hmph, alright then.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Closure's hiding in here, isn't she? I'm still waiting on at least ten modification requests! I won't let her get—Ah! I don't need your consolation, my stabilizers aren't fully tuned, that's all. I don't even have my beak! I could at least get a hydraulic pincer and a bumper and a flamethrower and a propeller, no?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Stop trying to set me up with fowlbeasts, I have no relation to those primitive Terran animals. At most, we're a result of convergent evolution. If you truly care about my well-being in that way, then find me something chicken egg-like to put in my hut. I think THAT hot water kettle of yours would work just fine, yes?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: BAWK-BAWK BAWK-BAWK!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Are you the leader of these humans? Then do something about that 'HR operator' outside, who insists on filling in my race as 'Liberi' or whatever. I've said it a thousand times, I'm a chicken! An actual chicken! Is that so hard to understand?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You're telling me they aren't going through all this to catch prey, or to court mates? How Kal'tsit-y of them.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What are you all so tall for?! Move, move, I can't see where I'm going.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You, you, you, and you, charge in, the louder the better. That's the plan.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Kal'tsit, we're going!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Does every human look the same? What a tremendous backslide for evolution.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Back when I fetched specimens for Kal'tsit, I was free to do things my way.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: You have better things to do than command a chicken, no?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm truly underwhelmed by how you humans pick a nest…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's not as if I'm incubating. Why do I have to stay in one spot?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: (Violent crowing and flapping of the few remaining feathers)

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Am I really that unappetizing now? Hmph.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Oh my. You can't even catch a ten-thousand-year-old chicken?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: As I thought, you were scarier back when you had fur.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Did you see that? In the end, chickens are the ultimate rulers of this planet.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You've done all the research you needed to, yes? I'm eating the specimens… You won't let me? Why should a chicken care about your humanisms?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They run so slow, it's like they're wriggling. How do you hold yourselves back from chasing them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Kal'tsit, do something, I'll die at this rate!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Are houses that can run about some kind of trend nowadays?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Stop clawing at your hood? Impossible. My feet are itchy.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yes, yes, the weather vane is very fun. Now, what about my tail? Is it that uninteresting to you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The scones? Um, I just ate the last one. Calm down, give me a second—*glark*, *cough* *cough*, *bleuch*—there, it's yours. Eat it. What are you looking at me like that for? I didn't digest it, I just let it make friends with my interior for a bit. Shut up and eat!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Preen my pin feathers.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: My birthday? Is that when my egg was laid, or when I came out of my shell? Hah, don't think too hard about it, I don't know when either day was anyway. For that matter, I don't know if your birthday is when you were born, or when you awoke as the Doctor. It's the day I can give you sandworm legs, and that's all I need.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The last chicken, and the last human. Hah. It sounds so depressing. Still, those chickens who died or got buried or turned into Liberi forever ago don't matter to me. Caring for Kal'tsit is enough. What about you? Do you have to worry about everyone? Maybe, at least once in a while, find just one person to care for?
